connectors.name: UART1-OUT
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; horizontal row, started at the right end (side nearer the USB connectors on the right board edge). Labels printed as a block to the left of the connector, applied left-to-right to the pads.

connectors.name: I2C-OUT
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; horizontal row, started at the right end (nearer the USB connectors). Labels printed as a block to the right of the connector, applied left-to-right to the pads.

connectors.name: UART0-IN
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; horizontal row, started at the right end (nearer the USB connectors). Labels printed as a block to the right of the connector, applied left-to-right to the pads.

connectors.name: Wireless module header (left)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; vertical row, started at the bottom end (nearer the USB connectors). Labels taken from the left column of the legend box between J9 and J11, legend top row = top pad pair.

connectors.name: Wireless module header (right)
connectors.orderNote: No pin numbers; vertical row, started at the bottom end (nearer the USB connectors). Labels taken from the right column of the legend box between J9 and J11, legend top row = top pad pair.

uncertain: J15, J13 and J10 labels are printed as a separate text block beside each 4-pad JST footprint, not next to individual pads; the left-to-right label order was mapped to the left-to-right pads by inference.

J9 and J11 are each drawn as 2x7 SMD pad footprints but the legend between them lists only 2x7 = 14 names; assignment of the legend's left column to J9 and right column to J11 (one name per pad pair, rows:1) is inferred, as is whether each pad pair is one pin.
notes: PCB render (V1.0, SKU DIS01835A). Skipped: SPK (J12) and BAT (J3) with only +/- marks, USB0/USB1, TF slot, MIC, buttons. Printed hyphen/underscore suffixes (IO18-RX1, IO15_SDA, IO43-TX0) split into GPIO label plus function. IIC address legend (IO15-RTC_SDA, IO16-RTC_SCL) refers to the RTC chip, not a connector.
